caption: Did Moses predict that Jesus would speak the Father’s words? Jesus fits the description, but speaking God’s message is a prophet’s basic role—not a unique identifier.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Moses predict Jesus’s words? God promises a prophet who will speak His words. Jesus later says he speaks exactly what the Father taught him.
slides.body: God promises a prophet who will speak His words. Jesus later says he speaks exactly what the Father taught him.
slides.heading: Did Moses predict Jesus’s words?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Deut 18:18: I will put My words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.
slides.body: I will put My words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.
slides.heading: Deut 18:18

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Jn 8:28–29, BSB: I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me.
slides.body: I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Jn 8:28–29

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them Jesus says the Father sent him, and Acts identifies him with the prophet promised by Moses.
